label: Labreche 2018
setting: university optometry clinics (Waterloo Optometry and Vision Science: primary care, ocular health and low vision clinics)
diagnosis_mix: NR (various visual impairments associated with falls)
recruitment: consecutive from three clinics, deliberately enriched with visually impaired patients from Ocular Health and Low Vision clinics; full eye exam within previous 4 months; phone interviews May-Aug 2013 and 2014; retrospective chart review
notes: 93 participated; 1 refused TICS-M, 2 incomplete VIRFQ, 1 declined all questions -> 89 (p4). Abstract says 53 impaired + 33 normal (86). Impairment from routine chart data (best corrected VA, CS, Amsler/confrontation/perimetry); fields and stereopsis not measured in many (p5). Reference standard is falls-related visual impairment, not LVR need. Subgroup TICS-M >21 = no cognitive impairment (n=52).
